This pump is used to transfer 
 hydrazine and ammonia to the boiler

The Pump 
 Technical Data:

المسودة الأولى 
بدأ بواسطة المهندس. عبدالله مصطفى سعدة اختبار م. أحمد الصعيدي، 
مقبولة من قبل المهندس. خميس الشريف : مدير عام الصيانة و معتمد من 
م. عبد المعطي الركايبي رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء المحمودية.

This document 
reviewed by eng. Magdey Hegazy, accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
inspection & quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality controls head sector.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

يجب أن يكون موظفو الصيانة مدربين ومؤهلين و 
 تحمل فئة سلامة الهوية المناسبة.

يوجد سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل 
 مطلوب.

Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Shut down the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
أغلق صمامات الإغلاق الموجودة في (الشفط والتفريغ).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured 
 at the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other 
 supply lines.

The safety department must check the isolation and 
 surrounding the zone of work.

sections.text:
Pump out of serves 
(Dismantling)
Disconnect the motor electrically.

Isolate the pump ( Close the isolating valves ) and drain it as completely as 
 possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping ( water cooling ).
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.

Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as 
 pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from suction and discharge piping.
Remove coupling spacer.]
Drain the oil.
Remove the casing adapter frame nuts.
اسحب مبيت المحمل الكامل باستخدام الدوار.

Carry the complete bearing housing with rotor eventually to the workshop to 
 continue dismantling.

sections.text: Steps of maintenance:
التحقق من معدل الجرعات وضيق. في حالة تسرب المكبس، استبدل العبوة

The gear oil should be changed (Gear oil : ISO viscosity class VG 150, mobil 
 gear 629)
All filters should be checked and cleaned
يجب استبدال الأجزاء المكسورة
Check the bearing and changing if necessary
Check the wear rings
Check smooth slid.
